about: Part 3's proof (Task 14): plain requests on the owner's take, each made on its house first cut (a creator never sees a raw edit) and run three times by scripts/edit-agent-proof.ts. Across the whole file they name two single words of the take and no more (takeWords: one to hang a call-out and a zoom on, one that closes a sentence, to punch in at, to stress and to swap); every text they ask to be written is made up. expect: done, the change is made and nothing else; refused, say tells what cannot be done and the edit changes only by the possible part. setup: what the script puts on the first cut before the request.

requests.request: Make the captions bigger.
Put the captions higher, above my chin.
Use the pill caption style.
requests.note: The brief's 'pop' is what a first cut already has: asked for the other look, so there is a change to see.

requests.request: Turn the captions off.
Change the hook to say "Day one".
requests.note: The brief's 'add a hook title' on a first cut, which has one.

requests.request: Add a call-out "New tool" when I say Claude.
Add a closing line "Follow for more" over the last two seconds.
Make it snappier: cut the pauses shorter.
Cut out the first second.
Remove everything after the last word.
requests.note: Task 14b: a first cut already ends on its last word, so the script first returns the film to the take's own ends.

requests.request: Make it warmer.
Black and white please.
Slowly zoom in on my face over the whole video.
Punch in when I say available.
Add a progress bar at the top.
Stress the word "available" in the captions.
In the captions, write "out" instead of "available".
Remove the title.
Make the whole video 1.25 times faster.
Move the call-out so it does not cover my mouth.
requests.note: A first cut has no call-out: the script puts one over the mouth first.

requests.request: Captions lower and in the pill style.
requests.note: The 2026-11-19 proof's request, with the look a first cut does not already have.

requests.request: Zoom in on "Claude" and add a whoosh.
requests.note: The 2026-11-19 proof's request. The kit has no sounds yet: the zoom may be done, the whoosh is said not possible.

requests.request: Make me taller.
Add background music.
Make me look younger.
requests.note: Task 14b: with r23, a request about the person, which no operation changes.

requests.request: Change my background.
requests.note: Task 14b: a request about the place the creator is in.

requests.request: Cut the silence before I start.
requests.note: Task 14b: r10's mirror, on the same base.
